name: Pediatrics Emergency Triage Form
description: Used to triage sick newborns and children at the pediatric emergency department or outpatient clinic. It opens with the triage type (neonate, pediatric emergency or pediatric OPD) and records vital signs, anthropometry, the emergency and priority signs for that type, the assigned triage level, immediate actions for newborns, and basic and referral information.

questions.label: Newborn triage signs (tick all present)
questions.questionInfo: RED (emergency): apnoea or gasping, severe respiratory distress, central cyanosis, shock, convulsions or unresponsive - resuscitate and stabilise at once, do not delay for registration. YELLOW (urgent): abnormal vital signs, suspected sepsis, poor feeding or lethargy, significant jaundice, hypothermia, prematurity or low birth weight - prompt clinician assessment. GREEN (stable): no emergency signs, stable breathing and circulation.
